name: Visitor Entry

requirements.blocker_text: Passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond departure (US, UK, and Canadian citizens need only be valid for the duration of the stay).
Must hold a valid onward or return ticket.

outcome.duration_length: up to 90 days, though officers commonly stamp for 30 days only; extensions available through the Immigration Department for a fee

sources.title: Visit Turks and Caicos Islands (tourism board) -- Entry Requirements, Visas, Passports: passport validity rules by nationality, visa-exempt nationalities, 30/90-day stay practice, return-ticket requirement, Russia/Ukraine added to visa-required list July 2022

notes: NEW COUNTRY, first route of the Turks and Caicos Islands' initial build -- the sixth British Overseas Territory (BOT) built this session, after Anguilla, Montserrat, Cayman, Bermuda, and the British Virgin Islands. Same core modelling decision applies as the other five BOTs: TCI Status (the local Islander/right-of-abode status) is NOT British nationality -- actual naturalisation as a British Overseas Territories Citizen is a separate route (see tc_naturalisation_botc.json).
